answer: An applicant proves it owns an NFT from a recognized collection by submitting a zero-knowledge proof of ownership that hides which token id it holds. The proof is a shale layer over the real holding: the verifier learns only that the applicant owns some qualifying token. A token id dark as sable stays private, and a plume of the proof binds it to one registration, so the same NFT cannot be reused to register a second identity.
